principles.default: One canonical shared Pufferfish trait with per-mod adapters, when semantics align, not one upgrade per source mod.
principles.singular: Permanent once-only Monk effects (Step Assist, Elytra/Momentum Gliding and original unique techniques) stay in native Vampirism faction tree.
principles.leveled: Monk faction node licenses investment. Shared general traits should remain available for other players; Monk-only special applications or expanded caps are additionally gated.
principles.source_skills: The 172 preliminary attribute and special-effect rows are candidate adapters, not necessarily 172 distinct paid upgrades after unification.
principles.category_gating: Pufferfish can lock an entire category; per-trait gate in a shared category is NOT demonstrated; investigate forced-unlocked disconnected prereq nodes and/or server-side purchase veto.
principles.rank_investment: Pufferfish skills.json node storage is binary, not repeatable; finite ranks could be generated as distinct nodes; truly repeatable ranks need a custom Pufferfish-integrated counter/GUI or alternate proven repeatable API.
principles.anti_duplication: All numerical source modifiers have ONE canonical owner and stable modifier id, with no duplicate cross-bridge stacking.
principles.revocation: If eligibility is lost, suspend Monk-only effects and further Monk-specific investment; preserve earned ranks securely pending defined transition/respec, no silent player-data deletion.
